notes.title: Upcoming update!
notes.notes:
Here we are after a long wait. The update that we mentioned on our social network is ready and needs a bit polishing and testing. Should be ready in few days to go. 
Some of the highlights that we did like to mention are:

* Brand new world Color Barrier with its own appealing music.
* Story line 
* Difficulty Adjustments to previous worlds
* Mechanism improvement for better gameplay.
* Other fixes.
